name: Supanova Comic Con & Gaming – Gold Coast
blurb: Gold Coast leg of Australia's multi-city Supanova tour, bringing film/TV, anime and gaming guests, comic creators and cosplay to the Gold Coast Convention & Exhibition Centre.

editions.evidence: Supanova's own site footer promo ticker (seen on supanova.com.au guest pages) lists 'Gold Coast April 10-11, 2027' at the Gold Coast Convention & Exhibition Centre.

notes: Today is 2026-10-05; this city's 2026 Supanova show already happened (its dedicated /events/gold-coast-2026/ pages are a passed-event archive, confirmed guests shown there are explicitly '... 2026' and so stale). The next edition's own event-home/guests pages (…-2027/) are not live yet (404), so the exact dates above come from the cross-promotional date ticker Supanova runs on its other live city pages (e.g. the Brisbane guests page footer), not yet from a dedicated page for this city. Guests for that edition are therefore none-yet and url points to the main Supanova site rather than a page that would otherwise show last cycle's lineup.
